title: Item
description: One item: its file in items/ and the item that --json prints (DESIGN.md §2.1, §4.3). A field a later slice adds joins this schema in that slice.

id.description: The project key, a dash and a number from 1, such as BM-12. Never reused.

title.description: One line, with no control characters, line breaks or marks that reorder text (DESIGN.md §2.1).

labels.description: Free text, lowercased and de-duplicated (DESIGN.md §2.1). Left out while there are none.

items.description: One line, trimmed, with no capital letters.

design.description: A reference into a design doc, such as DESIGN.md#2.4, on one line. Left out when there isn't one.

written.description: One fingerprint per criterion's text as it was written at create: its SHA-256, in lower-case hex (DESIGN.md §2.1). Only a criterion command from an interactive terminal changes it afterwards, so slice 11's T5 can tell when a criterion was reworded or dropped. In no particular order, and left out while there are none.

criteria.description: The Done when list (DESIGN.md §2.3), numbered from 1 in commands. Left out while there are none.

verification.description: How the item reached done (DESIGN.md §2.7). Present only while the item is done: reopening moves it to previous_verification. Files written by slice 2 can still hold one on a shelved item.

previous_verification.description: The item's last verification record, from before it was last reopened. Each reopen from done replaces it. Left out until the item is first reopened from done.

history.description: One entry per move between states or edit, oldest first. Left out while there are none.

description.description: Free markdown. Left out when there isn't one.

key.description: A project key: up to 10 capital letters and digits, starting with a letter, such as BM.

time.description: An RFC 3339 time in UTC, to the second.

criterion.description: One criterion (DESIGN.md §2.3): what must be true, and how it's verified. With check, a script criterion. With neither a check nor (from slice 12) a judge, a manual one, which alone takes evidence.

text.description: What must be true, on one line.

check.description: A shell command, run in the project's root, whose exit code 0 shows the criterion holds. On one line.

evidence.description: For a manual criterion, a note saying where to look (gate G2). On one line.

verification.description: How an item reached done (DESIGN.md §2.7). Later slices add the commit, its ref, and the checks and judges that ran.

by.description: auto: the gates passed and no trigger fired. human: approved from the inbox. unchecked: done before the gates existed, so nothing checked it.

note.description: Why the record says what it does, such as that no gates ran.

move.description: One move between states (DESIGN.md §2.2, §4.3), or one edit or criterion accept, which has from equal to to and names the fields it changed (DESIGN.md §2.1).

via.description: The command that made the move. `status <id> <state>` records the command it maps onto. unknown appears only in --json output, never in a file: it stands for a command this version doesn't know, read from a file a newer tracker wrote. Such a file is listed, but this version never writes it back.

interactive.description: Whether stdin was a terminal: true for my own moves, false for an agent's (DESIGN.md §2.6).

reason.description: Why. Present for shelve and reopen, which need one, and left out otherwise. One line of at most 500 characters.

fields.description: For an edit, the fields it changed, in the item file's order, and for a criterion accept, written. Left out for a move.

kind_before.description: For an edit that changed kind, the kind it replaced, so the digest can list a move away from capability (DESIGN.md §2.6). Left out otherwise.

labels_removed.description: For an edit, the labels it removed, so the digest can list one that removed needs-review (DESIGN.md §2.6). Left out when it removed none.
